title: Not All Countries Celebrate Thanksgiving: On the Cultural Dominance in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper uses the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Political Coordinates Test (PCT) as benchmarks for abstract cultural objects. These tests explicitly evaluate and measure religious values (such as the importance of God and teaching religious faith) and moral/ethical opinions (such as views on abortion, homosexuality, and euthanasia) across different cultures and languages.
